title: ‘Our Risk, Their Reward’: Zohran Mamdani on AI and Data Centers
gist: In a WIRED interview, New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani says AI resembles the housing bubble, says he doesn't trust 'the Sam Altmans of the world,' and backs a one-year New York state pause on data center construction. He describes opposition to data centers as a bipartisan revolt against an AI politics of 'our risk, their reward.' He also lays out city AI rules (a generative-AI ban for students from 2K through eighth grade, no AI-generated apartment images, limits on chatbot 'doom loops') and his $1.2 billion Universal 2K childcare partnership with Governor Hochul.
